label: Simplified ITB rules for demo
note: Illustrative costs for the demo. Every number here is an assumption, not a quote or a policy value; confirm eligibility and costs with the Defence Investment Agency.

personal_certification.includes: New-entrant welder seat, all-in: college welding certificate tuition (domestic $3.3K–$4.6K), CWB W47.1 welder tests, PPE/tools and a living stipend
personal_certification.note: Upper end of an estimated $10K–$25K range. Re-qualifying an experienced welder costs ~$2K–$6K (tests $299–$499, Okanagan College; median wage $28/hr, Job Bank 2025-11-19). Sources: conestogac.on.ca, fanshawec.ca, mohawkcollege.ca, okanagancollege.ca. Assumption.

apprentice_sponsorship.includes: First-year sponsorship costs excluding wages (supervision, in-school fees, tools); wage-inclusive gross ~$50K–$60K
apprentice_sponsorship.note: Illustrative per-apprentice cost; not a quote. Offsets exist but may not stack with ITB credit: Build Canada Apprenticeship Service up to $10K (fall 2026), Ontario Achievement Incentive up to $17K. Source: CAF 2009 https://www.nist.gov/system/files/documents/2024/01/03/CAF-pays.pdf ; https://www.ontario.ca/page/financial-supports-apprentices-and-sponsors

welder_upgrade.note: Informational (display only); the engine does not use this key yet.

company_w47_1.note: Company certification; welder tickets are only valid at a CWB-certified company. Informational (display only); the engine does not use this key yet.

capacity_per_trainee_hours_week.note: Production hours per week a newly certified welder or apprentice adds to a shop.

cert_package_trainees.note: Default cohort size for a certification package (one college course section).

capacity.note: Demo assumption: capacity gaps are filled by sponsoring apprentices through an Indigenous-governed training institution (10x per the ITB overview).
capacity.real_example: Six Nations Polytechnic: tuition-free 26-week welder pre-apprenticeship (example, not affiliated; informational)
